Office Cleaning

What's included

A clean office makes a good first impression and keeps employees healthy. We build a written work schedule around your space, from daily trash, restrooms and kitchens to weekly dusting of desks, blinds and vents, and the same crew comes back so nothing is missed.

  • Workstations, desks, file cabinets and common areas
  • Conference, copy and file rooms
  • Kitchens, breakrooms and coffee areas
  • Restroom cleaning and restocking
  • Trash and recycling removal
  • Telephones, glass, doors and high-touch points
  • HEPA vacuuming, mopping and floor care

Ideal for

  • Corporate and professional offices
  • Engineering, insurance and real estate offices
  • Banks and service centers
  • Property managers of office buildings

How it works

  1. 1

    Free walkthrough

    We visit your facility and learn its traffic, risks and schedule.

  2. 2

    Custom work schedule

    You get a written scope with every task and its frequency, and a fair, fixed monthly price.

  3. 3

    Expert cleaning

    Our trained crew cleans and disinfects with color-coded microfiber and hospital-grade products.

  4. 4

    Quality control

    Regular inspections and fast follow-up keep standards high.

Frequently asked questions

How often should an office be cleaned?

Most offices need daily or every-other-day service for trash, restrooms and kitchens, plus a weekly detailed clean. We adapt the plan to your traffic.

Do you bring supplies and equipment?

Yes. We bring professional equipment and products. We can also restock paper and soap from your inventory or supply them.

Can you work at night or on weekends?

Yes. We schedule service when your office is empty so your team is never interrupted.
